answer: Reaching eligibility takes 61 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The dune register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and grove seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 61 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 334 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
